definitions.gloss: to surround; to encircle; to hang around (someone)
definitions.explanation: To be all around something or someone, physically or as circumstances. Very common in the abstract phrase 〜を{取|と}り{巻|ま}く{環境|かんきょう} (the situation surrounding ~). Of people, it can suggest a crowd of admirers or hangers-on around a figure.

examples.japanese: ⟦ファン→ファン：10065_fan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{歌手|かしゅ}→歌手：00197_kashu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{取|と}り{巻|ま}いた。
{子|こ}ども⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{取|と}り{巻|ま}く⟦{環境|かんきょう}→環境：00174_kankyou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{大|おお}きく→大きい：00335_ookii⟧⟦{変|か}わった→変わる：00714_kawaru⟧。
examples.english: The environment children grow up in has changed greatly.

examples.japanese: {日本経済|にほんけいざい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{取|と}り{巻|ま}く⟦{状況|じょうきょう}→状況：01576_joukyou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{厳|きび}しく→厳しい：01125_kibishii⟧、⟦{先行|さきゆ}き→先行き：27497_sakiyuki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{不透明|ふとうめい}→不透明：11365_futoumei⟧だ。
examples.english: The situation surrounding the Japanese economy is severe, and the outlook is uncertain.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY:
- Transitive: 〜⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{取|と}り{巻|ま}く; no intransitive pair

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- 〜⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{取|と}り{巻|ま}く⟦{環境|かんきょう}→環境：00174_kankyou⟧ / ⟦{状況|じょうきょう}→状況：01576_joukyou⟧: the environment / situation surrounding ~
- {取|と}り{巻|ま}き: hangers-on, an entourage (the noun)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{取|と}り{囲|かこ}む→取り囲む：20925_torikakomu⟧: to surround; more physical, often closing in on someone
- ⟦{囲|かこ}む→囲む：02037_kakomu⟧: to enclose, to surround; the general word
